title: Getting started with sdid
text: data balanced panel long format, one row per unit period. treatment column 1 treated unit first treated period onward, 0 otherwise. Proposition 99 data, California treated 1989. sdid() takes panel names columns, method inference, must given. Like Stata command, prints header describing data estimating, results. graph = TRUE, default, also draws trends plot, quietly = TRUE prints nothing, example within loop.
code: data(california_prop99) head(california_prop99) #>         State Year PacksPerCapita treated #> 1     Alabama 1970           89.8       0 #> 2    Arkansas 1970          100.3       0 #> 3    Colorado 1970          124.8       0 #> 4 Connecticut 1970          120.0       0 #> 5    Delaware 1970          155.0       0 #> 6     Georgia 1970          109.9       0 fit = sdid(california_prop99, outcome = "PacksPerCapita", unit = "State",            time = "Year", treatment = "treated", vce = "placebo", seed = 1213,            graph = FALSE) #>  #> Synthetic Difference-in-Differences Estimator #>  #> Outcome     PacksPerCapita #> Treatment   treated #> Units       39 (38 never treated, 1 treated) #> Periods     31 (1970 to 2000), treatment from 1989 #> Inference   placebo, 50 replications #>  #>  #>               ATT Std. Err.     z P>|z| [95% Conf. Interval] #> treated -15.60383  10.93638 -1.43 0.154  -37.03873   5.83108 #>  #> 95% confidence intervals and p-values use the normal approximation.

title: Getting started with sdid
text: result prints tables , standard methods extract parts. summary() adds, cohort, many controls pre-treatment periods carry weight, largest unit weights. weights() returns unit time weights data frames. unit weights pick states , together, track California’s trend 1989. time weights pick pre-treatment years whose average serves baseline comparison, 1986 1988.

title: Getting started with sdid
text: vce chooses standard error computed. "placebo" gives units never treated treatment pattern treated units re-estimates, reps replications. works single treated unit, , assumes controls’ noise resembles treated units’. "bootstrap" resamples whole units reps replications, needs one treated unit. "jackknife" leaves one unit time weights held fixed. staggered design needs one treated unit every cohort. "noinference" skips inference. Intervals p-values use normal approximation. alternative chooses one-sided test, whose direction chosen seeing estimate. one-sided interval open direction test. bound 95% bound two-sided interval 90%.
code: less = sdid(california_prop99, "PacksPerCapita", "State", "Year", "treated",             vce = "placebo", seed = 1213, alternative = "less",             graph = FALSE, quietly = TRUE) confint(less) #>          0 %     95 % #> treated -Inf 2.384911

title: Getting started with sdid
text: treated units first treated different periods, cohort units first treated period estimated units never treated, overall effect averages cohorts’ effects, weighted numbers treated units periods adoption. panel simulated, three cohorts adopting periods 6, 9 12. cohorts’ estimates, standard errors intervals printed overall effect stored staggered$cohorts. plots draw panel per cohort. quota data Bhalotra et al. (2023), staggered example Stata command, can read command’s repository.
code: set.seed(1) N = 30; periods = 15 adoption = c(rep(NA, 21), rep(c(6, 9, 12), each = 3)) panel = expand.grid(time = seq_len(periods), unit = sprintf("u%02d", seq_len(N))) i = as.integer(panel$unit) panel$treat = as.integer(!is.na(adoption[i]) & panel$time >= adoption[i]) panel$y = rnorm(N)[i] + 0.3 * panel$time + rnorm(nrow(panel), sd = 0.2) +   2 * panel$treat  staggered = sdid(panel, "y", "unit", "time", "treat", vce = "bootstrap",                  reps = 50, seed = 2, graph = FALSE) #>  #> Synthetic Difference-in-Differences Estimator #>  #> Outcome     y #> Treatment   treat #> Units       30 (21 never treated, 9 treated) #> Periods     15 (1 to 15), 3 adoption periods #> Inference   bootstrap, 50 replications #>  #>  #>           ATT Std. Err.     z P>|z| [95% Conf. Interval] #> treat 2.00672   0.03941 50.91 0.000    1.92947   2.08397 #>  #> Adoption-period estimates #>    Treated Post Weight     ATT Std. Err.     z P>|z| [95% Conf. Interval] #> 6        3   10 0.4762 2.03355   0.06411 31.72 0.000    1.90789   2.15920 #> 9        3    7 0.3333 1.94701   0.04495 43.31 0.000    1.85891   2.03511 #> 12       3    4 0.1905 2.04412   0.13318 15.35 0.000    1.78310   2.30514 #>  #> 95% confidence intervals and p-values use the normal approximation. quota = haven::read_dta(paste0(   "https://github.com/Daniel-Pailanir/sdid/raw/main/",   "simulations/cluster_data/quota_example_cluster.dta")) sdid(quota, "womparl", "country", "year", "quota", vce = "bootstrap",      reps = 200, seed = 1)

title: Updated Synthetic Difference-in-Differences Estimation and Inference for R
text: sdid estimates average effects treatment treated (ATT) panel data using synthetic difference--differences (SDiD), synthetic control (SC), difference--differences (). follows design Stata package sdid Clarke et al. (2024), function call accepts long format panel dataset, automatically detects whether staggered treatment approach needed, estimates effect bootstrap, jackknife, placebo inference. package derives synthdid 0.0.9 Arkhangelsky et al., (2021). Relative package, adds staggered adoption, optimized projected methods covariate adjustment, compiled estimation parallel replications, redesigned interface built around consolidated function.

title: Updated Synthetic Difference-in-Differences Estimation and Inference for R
text: development version can installed GitHub R-Universe.
code: # install.packages("remotes") remotes::install_github("alcocer-jj/sdid")  install.packages("sdid", repos = c("https://alcocer-jj.r-universe.dev",                                    "https://cloud.r-project.org"))

title: Updated Synthetic Difference-in-Differences Estimation and Inference for R
text: full call shown , argument’s default. arguments take one several values, first value listed default, except vce, default must given. data: balanced panel long format, one row per unit period. outcome: name outcome variable. unit: name unit identifier. time: name time period variable. treatment: name binary treatment variable, 1 denotes first post-treatment period. vce: inference method (required). covariates: names time-varying covariate variables, . method: synthetic , synthetic control, difference--differences. reps: number bootstrap placebo replications. seed: random seed, applied call . level: confidence level, percent. alternative: alternative hypothesis test effect zero. covariate.method: covariates adjusted . standardize: standardize covariates optimized method. projection.sample: regression sample projected method. num.threads: threads replications, available NULL. graph: produce trends plot call. quietly: TRUE prints nothing, use loops.
code: sdid(   data,   outcome,   unit,   time,   treatment,   vce = c("bootstrap", "jackknife", "placebo", "noinference"),   covariates = NULL,   method = c("sdid", "sc", "did"),   reps = 50,   seed = NULL,   level = 95,   alternative = c("two.sided", "greater", "less"),   covariate.method = c("optimized", "projected"),   standardize = TRUE,   projection.sample = c("controls", "untreated"),   num.threads = NULL,   graph = TRUE,   quietly = FALSE,   ... )

Default 1. time column number/name corresponding time identifier. Default 2. outcome column number/name corresponding outcome identifier. Default TRUE. covariates Optional column numbers names time-varying covariates. given, returned X, units x periods x covariates array whose rows columns order Y, ready pass synthdid_estimate. Covariates must numeric missing values. Defaults NULL. staggered TRUE accept staggered adoption, treated units adopt treatment different periods. Defaults FALSE, stops adoption simultaneous.
